canonical_neutral.anchor_measurement: Assistant visual registration on the native raster, approximate scene anatomy; not automatic alpha-box centering or subpixel alignment metrology.
canonical_neutral.anchor_basis: Round skull/trunk/feet height excludes the long ears above skull and white side tail; anchor uses midpoint of the two standing feet.
canonical_neutral.vertical_motion_policy: Consumer places this recorded anchor explicitly and designs any motion. No locomotion, ground shift or body normalization is inferred from this neutral PNG.

calibration.method: Exact reuse of adopted neutral geometry; no new drawing.

landmarks.observations: Native homologous head breadth/crown-to-chin and neck/torso-to-support relation manually compared with adopted neutral. One common isotropic reference for this original, shared across its acts; each independent single has its own original calibration. Excluded long ears, ossicone tips and tails follow canonical definition, rather than pose-wise alpha height fitting.
